name: Brass Rubbing
desc: Every plaque in the Gazetteer, read. A parish church let you rub their best brass knight in thanks. You've wax on your sleeve and history in your bones.

name: Macclesfield Silk Square
desc: A square of Macclesfield silk, woven on a Jacquard loom from a punched-card pattern. The curator says it's too good to blow your nose on. The curator is right.
